entries.7e6bdfbb2c8ec892: Since its founding, it has consistently aimed to provide management support to housing companies, offering a platform that supports the housing industry, and in recent years it has placed "the integration of housing finance services and cloud" at the center of its management strategy. In its management strategy for the fiscal year ending March 2027, against 2 major themes, "building homes at low cost" and "protecting homes and living", it states that in the short term it will promote diversification, higher value added and one-stop provision of specialized services, and in the long term it will focus on platform development and the promotion of strategic alliances.

entries.9fd2cf5b811ba3db: A housing finance services company that provides small and medium-sized housing businesses with home loans such as Flat 35, housing defect insurance and housing warranties, and cloud systems for housing businesses.
entries.a07af7f80c3abb01: The Description of Business section states that only 5 corporations nationwide designated by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism can sell housing defect insurance, which means high barriers to entry; that it is the only housing finance services company that covers the loan, insurance and guarantee financial services needed across the housing lifecycle and provides them integrated with cloud; that it promotes an accumulative business model that cross-sells loans, insurance and guarantees for each individual house; and that the Housing Defect Insurance and Related Business has the largest number of housing businesses as counterparties among its 3 segments.
entries.aa4b54b7ebf54c95: It is a mechanism in which it lends housing loans to consumers through housing businesses, and also provides housing defect insurance, housing guarantees and cloud systems matched to each individual house, earning fees, insurance and guarantee premiums, interest and other consideration.
